summary: Frontend regression testing for the admin-vs-public-user isolation fix. All 3 code changes (Protected wrapper redirect for admins, AdminSidebar 'Ver sitio público' link with target=_blank, AdminHeader dropdown item with window.open) verified end-to-end via Playwright against the public URL. Admin never sees the common-user Dashboard anymore, and common users are unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: Protected wrapper in /app/frontend/src/App.js correctly guards user-only routes; admin redirect via Navigate to='/admin' works for /dashboard, /perfil, /planes, /objetivos, /diagnostico/:sessionId, /agentes/mi-perfil.
AdminSidebar 'Ver sitio público' item renders as an <a href='/' target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'> — behaves exactly as required; no internal navigation to /dashboard.
AdminHeader dropdown item 'admin-menu-view-site' opens a popup at / (verified via page.expect_popup); 'admin-menu-profile' navigates to /admin/perfil.
Common-user path unaffected: maria@example.com login lands on /dashboard and all user routes (/dashboard, /perfil, /agentes, /foro, /convocatorias, /planes) remain accessible.
Reverse protection (common user hitting /admin) still shows the 'Acceso restringido' AdminRestricted screen.

Non-blocking console warnings observed in /perfil: shadcn Select component switching between controlled/uncontrolled (repeats multiple times). Not a regression from this fix, but worth cleaning up (initialize value with '' or defined default in ProfilePage).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix is verified working. Verified flows: (1) admin login -> /admin, (2) admin direct-URL to /dashboard,/perfil,/planes,/objetivos,/diagnostico/:id,/agentes/mi-perfil all redirect to /admin and AdminDashboard renders (admin-motor-status-widget visible), (3) AdminSidebar 'Ver sitio público' is an <a target=_blank href=/> with data-testid='admin-sidebar-view-site', (4) AdminHeader dropdown item data-testid='admin-menu-view-site' triggers window.open('/','_blank') — confirmed popup opened landing page; data-testid='admin-menu-profile' navigates to /admin/perfil, (5) common user maria@example.com can still access /dashboard,/perfil,/agentes,/foro,/convocatorias,/planes, (6) common user visiting /admin gets 'Acceso restringido'. No regressions detected.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the original bug: the Protected wrapper let admins render user-only pages (Dashboard, Profile, etc.) because it only gated on `!user`. Additionally the AdminSidebar/AdminHeader had a 'Ir a la plataforma' entry that performed internal navigation to /dashboard, taking admins into the public product UI. Fix: (a) Protected now short-circuits with <Navigate to='/admin'/> when user.is_admin || user.admin_role, (b) the sidebar/header items were renamed 'Ver sitio público' and were changed to open '/' in a new tab (target=_blank / window.open). Verified end-to-end — issue no longer reproduces.
